body.title: Spec↔code coupling + honest Lattice trail
body.problem: Agents implement UI and product changes without a sealed bet or open turn (violating TN-002 in spirit). Lattice then shows file lists and bare node ids instead of the plan story; Verify shows cryptic SL-00N badges without statements. Nothing flags product paths that are not covered by sealed spec, and nothing requires an align-approve JSON before push/PR/CI — skip is too easy by silence.
body.objective: Dogfood UI: plan-first turns, denser lists, human Verify report, architecture touch with workstream+features, sidebar wordmark specLedger. Product changes require path coverage against sealed plan+graph (or explicit waiver). A cheap align agent writes approve review JSON bound to treeDigest after user-supplied coverage intent; turn close, pre-push/pre-PR, and CI (pnpm ledger:align) fail without approve or waiver. verify.ok stays claims-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Human-reviewed bet prose lives under docs/workstreams/ as a title-slug Markdown file; .spec-ledger holds JSON metadata only and links via specPath (repo-relative)
Sidebar wordmark is specLedger (bold 'spec', regular 'Ledger'); no 'Bets → turns → claims' subtitle under the brand

Turn detail leads with plan loaded from workstream specPath Markdown (before/after + ask), before→after diagram or flows, commit subject/body, related docs; FileDiffCard lists product files; build artifacts (.next, node_modules) excluded from impact lists
Architecture touch shows workstream link + named features (+ claim count), not only bare node ids
Verify page: covered totals (e.g. required pass/total) plus each verdict row shows claim statement primary and id secondary

Align coverage: product path is covered if it matches a graph node.locator under the turn's featureIds OR a slice expectedPaths[] entry; .spec-ledger/** and ignore globs exempt; uncovered paths reported
Code-target align approve requires treeDigest, coverageSource, uncoveredPaths (empty) or waiverIds; reviewer starts with policy.alignReviewerPrefix and must not equal turn producer
Explicit skip writes align-waiver JSON: reason (>= policy.alignWaiverMinReasonChars), actor, treeDigest, workstreamId/turnId; max alignSkipMaxPerTurn; silence is not skip; audit lists waivers
turn close refuses product-file turns without covering align-approve or waiver for that treeDigest when requireAlignApprove
scripts/git-hooks pre-push (+ documented pre-PR) and CI step 'pnpm ledger:align' fail without approve/waiver for product diffs; pnpm verify / verify workflow remain claims-pure and separate
skills/sl-dev-align/SKILL.md exists and AGENTS.md points hosts at it: cheap/Haiku-class model, ask user for coverage intent before approve
outOfScope: Hosting or running cloud LLMs inside @nessa/spec-ledger core
Making align findings affect verify.ok / ledgerDigest
Write/mutate Lattice UI (forms that change ledger)
Replacing human seal with agent seal
Semantic line-by-line 'is this justified by prose' beyond path coverage

suggestedSlices.title: Lattice: plan-first UX + brand + human Verify
acceptance: Wordmark specLedger (bold spec); drop path subtitle under brand
Turn page loads plan from titled Markdown at workstream specPath
Turn page order: plan → before/after → commit → docs → trail → FileDiffCard → collapsed architecture/ledger
Architecture touch: workstream + feature names; ignore .next/node_modules in file impact
Verify: covered totals + statement-first verdict rows

suggestedSlices.title: Align check: path coverage vs sealed plan + graph
acceptance: CLI `spec-ledger align check` (and/or audit findings) reports uncovered product paths for a turn or working tree vs sealed workstream
Coverage = graph node.locator under turn featureIds OR slice expectedPaths[]; .spec-ledger and ignore globs exempt

suggestedSlices.title: Align approve review + explicit waiver JSON
acceptance: review schema+CLI support treeDigest, uncoveredPaths, coverageSource, waiverIds on code reviews
Refuse align approve when uncoveredPaths non-empty without waiverIds; refuse when reviewer is producer or missing align prefix
schemas/align-waiver.json + write/list waiver; reason length and actor enforced
skills/sl-dev-align/SKILL.md: Haiku-class/cheap model; ask user for coverage intent; AGENTS.md links it

suggestedSlices.title: Gates: turn close + hooks + CI
acceptance: turn close enforces requireAlignApprove unless waiver present for treeDigest
scripts/git-hooks pre-push (+ docs for pre-PR) fail without approve/waiver for product diffs
package.json script ledger:align; CI runs it separately from verify
